# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/commits/{sha}.{diffType}

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |

| sha | path | string | True |
| diffType | path | string | True |
